inputs: cloud-request-facts-2 prepared outputs, externally pinned by v24 diagnostics
grouping: principal_reference only. Missing principal/time has unavailable history, never global fallback. Issuer/IP equality is not a physical device or session assertion.
ordering: Event time ascending. Features use only strictly earlier timestamps within the preceding10/60 seconds. All equal-time events are withheld until the entire tie group is evaluated. Returned rows keep original case IDs and order.
duplicates: An identical repeated event reference/view contributes once to history; every source row/label remains. Later conflicting reference content yields unavailable enrichment and does not retroactively change earlier observations.
features: Fixed count/ratio buckets for observed calls10/60s, writes/errors60s, API and resource diversity60s, missing resource evidence60s and observed prefix age. No absolute time, raw identifiers, scenario names or labels as features.
censoring: Public logs may be sampled or incomplete. Zero is zero observed history, not proof of no activity. No continuous collection/current cryptographic trust is certified.
truth: Opaque byte-identical truth sidecars; no relabeling, row filtering or final-data reads
models: No classifier fit or final-test selection in this preparation stage. Gold-based collision diagnostics are training information bounds only.
